name: check_room_availability
description: check_room_availability: Check available conference rooms matching the specified building, date, time window, and minimum capacity. Optionally filter by floor and required equipment. Returns a list of available rooms with their codes, floors, capacities, and equipment.

building_code.description: Building code or common name/alias (e.g. BLD3, Headquarters, Downtown). Returns name_not_found if unrecognized.

date.description: The booking date in YYYY-MM-DD format (e.g. 2026-08-15).

floor_code.description: Floor code (e.g. FL2). **Omit this field entirely** (do not include the key) to search all floors in the building — do not pass an empty string or null.

equipment_required.description: Equipment that must be present in the room. Allowed values: projector, whiteboard, video_conferencing, display_screen, speakerphone. Only rooms with all listed items are returned. Optional — omit if the caller has no equipment requirements.
